overall_summary: Analysis of the data reveals a clear outlier preference for husband-wife relationship themes, while general heartbreak poetry or niche family topics underperformed. However, due to limited sample size, confidence is moderate.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,674 views) and 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,766 views) significantly outperformed all other content categories.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on mature, relatable relationship dynamics between partners.

weak_patterns.pattern: Standalone Heavy Sad Shayari / Abstract Pain
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing heavily on abstract sadness or bitter poetry like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received very low engagement (14 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic or abstract poetic rants; anchor the emotion to tangible real-life scenarios.
